note: The main banks: Maduro & Curiel's Bank (Bonaire), RBC Royal Bank and Banco di Caribe, Bonaire's largest retail banks. RBC Royal Bank's Bonaire credit cards page (rendered 30 October 2026): its personal RBC Rewards Visa Platinum, Visa Gold and Visa Classic International, in US dollars, each with its annual fee and its 18% purchase and cash advance rates; its business cards aren't written, and the page states no other fee. Saba's page prices the Visa Classic International at 50 dollars a year; Bonaire's is written. Maduro & Curiel's Bank (Bonaire)'s credit cards, services and fees page (read 30 October 2026): its Visa Classic, Mastercard Classic and Visa Aadvantage (no annual fee given, written as none), Visa Platinum Aadvantage ($135) and Mastercard Black Consumer ($175), in US dollars, each at 18% a year, with its late payment fee, an over limit fee of 10% of the excess up to $15 or $25, and a cash advance fee of 3% at an ATM, at least $15 (3.18% at a teller, not written). Its fraud protection fee is given without its period and isn't written, nor are the optional balance protection and the lost or stolen card fee; the page states no minimum payment, foreign transaction fee or penalty rate. Banco di Caribe's site sits behind a Cloudflare check and wasn't read. This file kept RBC's Visa Classic International, read on 29 October 2026. Wave 4 (30 October 2026) looked for more banks and added none: CIBC Caribbean's schedules for Bonaire aren't among those its site serves, and Banco di Caribe's fees page gives its Curaçao card charges (written in the Curaçao file), not Bonaire's. No minimum payment is published for Maduro & Curiel's Bank's (Bonaire) and RBC's cards; tried (wave 5, 30 October 2026): every document this file cites, downloaded again on 30 October 2026 and searched for a minimum payment, states none for them; RBC's Caribbean credit card pages for the country state no minimum payment; no web search was made for them in this wave, the searches shared by every agent having gone to the larger countries; archive.org's availability API names no snapshot of the 2 documents this file cites.
